summary: Georgia lookout list places a Davidson tower in Laurens County at 355 ft; no source found describes its build, height or state today.

That Davidson entry is in Laurens County

notes_for_editor: Thin record: two list entries only (Dunigan's table row with coordinates and 355 ft; the Eastern US Lookouts name entry).
